svg.title: EnzAIme system architecture
svg.desc: Confirmed data and frozen protein representations feed controlled research. A separate legacy model serves predictions and rankings with confirmed evidence. Mutation extraction exists; mutation and structure validation are proposed.
svg.text: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE / Environment-aware TPA prediction & protein exploration
Implemented • provenance is retained from source evidence through candidate metadata
Confirmed 221-row dataset + indexed embeddings • identical protein-grouped folds across A / B / C
Shared splits for A, B and C
Confirmed conditions + targets and frozen embeddings
* PCA: 10 components for B/C; all learned preprocessing is fitted within training folds.
Implemented • evidence comes from confirmed records; scores come from the existing legacy artifacts
Predicted TPA in µM • ranked list
Legacy metadata reports 227 records. Exact training/evaluation row membership is unresolved.
Research results are reported separately; the controlled experiments do not replace the served artifacts.
Existing extraction is a supporting branch; mutation scoring and structural validation remain proposed.
Map project proteins through UniProt accessions
Retain matching mutation records and source measurements
Proposed: residue mapping, mutant assessment, structural context
Requires validated methods and experimental confirmation
SOLID = IMPLEMENTED DASHED = PROPOSED • TPA / PET research scope
